name: subagents-ai
description: SubAgents AI — Multi-agent loop framework desktop app
author: SubAgents AI

scripts.smoke: node scripts/smoke.mjs && node --experimental-strip-types scripts/smoke-platform.mts && node scripts/smoke-caps.mjs && node scripts/smoke-scenario-e2e.mjs && node --experimental-strip-types scripts/smoke-prod-modules.mts && npm run smoke:marketplace
scripts.smoke:ci: node scripts/smoke.mjs && node --experimental-strip-types scripts/smoke-platform.mts && node scripts/smoke-caps.mjs && node scripts/smoke-scenario-e2e.mjs && node --experimental-strip-types scripts/smoke-prod-modules.mts
scripts.dist: npm run smoke && npm run build && npm run smoke:built && electron-builder
scripts.dist:mac: npm run smoke && npm run build && npm run smoke:built && electron-builder --mac
scripts.dist:win: npm run smoke && npm run build && npm run smoke:built && electron-builder --win
scripts.dist:all: npm run smoke && npm run build && npm run smoke:built && electron-builder --mac --win
